description: Three-stage phaser, with a dry and wet balance and a separate control over the feedback

params.text: Crossfades the output between the dry signal and the phased signal
Sets the frequency of the three allpass stages, 61Hz at the bottom of its travel and 838Hz at the top
Sets the emphasis of the phaser, turning it up as the knob is raised
Shifts the phase the wet signal is mixed back at, -1 to +1

inputs.text: The signal fed into the phaser
Shifts the phase offset, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Shifts the allpass frequency, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Shifts the emphasis, 10V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Shifts the dry and wet balance, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it

outputs.text: The dry and phased signals mixed according to the blend knob
